title: SEC Form 4 Insider Trades
description: Insider buys and sells from SEC Form 4 filings for any ticker: insider name and role, transaction date, code (open-market purchase, sale, grant, option exercise), shares, price, dollar value, holdings after, and a link to the filing.
why: Parsed straight from each Form 4's XML, one row per transaction line, with the code translated. Tick open-market only to see conviction buys and sells.
useCases: Investors and newsletters tracking insider conviction
Quant and AI agents building insider-sentiment signals
IR and compliance teams monitoring their own filings

filedSince.title: Filed on or after (YYYY-MM-DD)
filedSince.description: Only Form 4s filed on or after this date.

openMarketOnly.title: Open-market buys and sells only
openMarketOnly.description: Only transaction codes P and S.

limits: Insiders are named exactly as on the public Form 4.
